subject.title: Multi-profile profile targeting/config truth is ambiguous with ~/.openclaw-* homes on macOS

question: What should the macOS profile-targeting contract be when an explicit root `--profile` conflicts with inherited LaunchAgent identity, profile-name casing, or separate `.openclaw-*` homes?
rationale: Source inspection confirms a stale-label subcase, but deciding explicit-profile precedence, profile casing, supported mixed-home layouts, and custom label behavior changes the operator contract and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Make explicit profile authoritative
options.body: Treat root `--profile` as the selected config/state/service target, clear only stale OpenClaw-managed launchd labels, preserve intentional custom labels, and make status output show the resolved profile, config, state, and service target.

options.title: Preserve label override precedence
options.body: Keep `OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_LABEL` stronger than `--profile` and document nested cross-profile lifecycle commands as unsupported unless the operator clears service identity manually.

options.title: Defer to broader profile design
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella until maintainers decide casing, mixed-home support, service-label precedence, and host-surface proof together.

recommendation.title: Make explicit profile authoritative
recommendation.body: Treat root `--profile` as the selected config/state/service target, clear only stale OpenClaw-managed launchd labels, preserve intentional custom labels, and make status output show the resolved profile, config, state, and service target.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the original CLI profile support and current multi-gateway docs contract.
